name: com.sst-systems.stableref
description: Serializable polymorphic reference wrapper built on [SerializeReference] that survives class renames. Stores a stable string type ID alongside the object. Includes editor tools: searchable type selector, find-usages window, and missing-types report.

samples.description: StableRefJsonConverter: StableRef<T> / StableRefList<T> fields read and write the same JSON as bare T / List<T> fields. Requires Newtonsoft.Json in the project (com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json or any Newtonsoft.Json.dll). Includes EditMode tests.
